items.title: Canadian Woman Discovers Dressing for the Weather
items.summary: At six, I knew more or less how to dress appropriately for the weather. At twenty-six, I could not. At six, I knew the rules: when it is cold, wear sweaters. When there is a lot of snow on the ground, wear parkas and snow pants and snow boots. When it is hot, wear t-shirts and shorts.
